description: This file defines the ViewModel for the Detail screen in an Android TV Recipe Guide app. It manages loading recipe details by ID, toggling favorite status, and maintains UI state.

classes.name: DetailViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing recipe detail data, including loading details and toggling favorites.

classes.name: DetailUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the UI states of the detail screen (Loading, Success, Error).

methods.name: loadRecipe
methods.description: Loads recipe data by ID, updating UI state accordingly.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe by ID and reloads the data.
